clips.title: The story
paras: Krusk wants Lord Aliden Perenolde dead, and the Warchief's pendant recovered. Perenolde's manor lies north, on Lordamere Lake; his mistress Elysa knows about the pendant.

After Blackmoore's Legacy, Krusk says Perenolde must die and his foulness be ended. His manor lies north, on the shores of Lordamere Lake at Dandred's Fold. Once the deed is done, ask his mistress Elysa about Taretha's pendant, which the Warchief desires.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Do your duty, friend, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: No, no please don't hurt me! I never meant your people any harm, he's had me against my will! Please... Spare me!
